name: Indoor Crowd Movement Trajectory Benchmark Dataset
description: A vision benchmark dataset for indoor crowd movement trajectories recorded from a large academic conference venue, intended to study indoor positioning, crowd movement patterns, and behavioral analysis in a complex multi-activity environment.
evaluation_method: Trajectory prediction and movement-pattern evaluation, typically using trajectory error metrics and task-specific measures derived from inferred paths or activity/mobility classification.
general_score_metric: lower is better for prediction error; higher is better for classification-style subtasks
notes: The dataset covers over 5,000 participants across varied indoor conference activities. Exact benchmark protocol and question count are not specified in the provided metadata.
